scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-colosseum --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-colosseum "vitest run tests/firestore.rules"
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-colosseum "vitest run tests/functions.emulator"
